As is always the case in game dev, the whole ordeal took a lot longer than expected, but we got there eventually![/p][p]Check out the (non-exhaustive) list of changes below: 📋[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]New accessibility options[/b][/p][list][*][p]Auto Crafting[/p][/*][*][p]Disable Typing Text[/p][/*][*][p]Reduce Wet sounds (now under accessibility options)[/p][/*][*][p]Hopscotch help: Simple Mode and auto hopscotch[/p][/*][*][p]Enable / Disable rumble[/p][list][*][p]Rumble intensity offset[/p][/*][*][p]Caravan rumble[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Auto Run -> Manual/ Automatic / toggle[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Controls[/b][/p][list][*][p]Right clicking to drop item will now walk you where you right clicked to drop item.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Caravan Interior Decor 🛋️[/b][/p][list][*][p]Each caravan customisation set now has a matching caravan interior decor. [/p][/*][*][p]Caravan Customisations and Wardrobe packs are now locked behind quests and doing tasks for characters around the world. [/i]⚠️[/b][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Tutorial[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated start of game tutorial, introducing player to postcards and more clarity about where to go.[/p][/*][*][p]You can show your tutorial salad to Arthur for some bonus dialogue. 🥗[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Activities[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed the long delay before hitchhikers disembarked the Caravan.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Dill sometimes spawning at world origin instead of at his Jumps. [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Visuals[/b][/p][list][*][p]All shaders rebuilt and optimised. 👷[/p][/*][*][p]Overlay effect when the player is obscured now correctly removes antlers, crests, etc.[/p][list][*][p]Still showing on outlines though, we'll get to it![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Depth of Field effect is now a consistent strength regardless of resolution. 📸[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Optimisations[/b][/p][list][*][p]New streaming system to improve performance and reduce memory usage. notes.title: Content Update v0.4.5 — Sweater Late Than Never! 🧥
notes.content: [p]Hey Cozy Caravaners! 👋[/p][p]We know it's been a little quiet on our end, so we wanted to share a small update to let you know, we’re still here, and still hard at work! 😅[/p][p]So as a sneaky little "sign of life", we’re releasing a handful of new outfits that have been tucked away in the wardrobe, just waiting for someone to wear them.[/p][p][/p][h1]New Outfits!✨[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/2fe95aa65ac27ba91fcc0b4826ed4d8f27770e2d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]These new outfits will [b]unlock immediately[/b] once you purchase the wardrobe upgrade from the Guild Catalogue, no additional Tokens required![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]What Have We Been Up To?[/h1][p]While this update is just a small one, there's been a lot going on behind the scenes, so we wanted to give a little update on what's been happening.[/p][p][/p][h3]Performance Improvements in Progress[/h3][p]As we mentioned in our last update, we've been doing a deep overhaul of the game's core systems. This work is aimed at making Cozy Caravan run faster, smoother, and more reliably—especially as we gear up for version 1.0.[/p][p]It’s been a big task, and we’ve been chipping away at it while also adding more content like new features, quests, outfits, and characters. For example, if you're playing on [b]Steam Deck[/b], you’ll be happy to hear areas like Clamberry are already seeing much better frame rates, jumping from struggling to maintain 30fps to frequently hitting 60fps or more! (And using less memory, too.) There's still some work to do with some hitches in the new streaming system, but progress is looking good.[/p][p][/p][h3]Cozy Caravan is Coming to Nintendo Switch![/h3][p]And some of you may have seen the news, but if you missed it, [b]Cozy Caravan is officially coming to Nintendo Switch[/b] at our 1.0 launch![/p][p]We’ve had requests for a Switch version ever since we launched in Early Access, so we’re thrilled to finally confirm it. 🎉[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]We'll have more exciting news to share in the near future, so thanks as always for your ongoing support![/p][p]Want to chat with us or share your outfit screenshots? Join the community on [url="https://discord.gg/dxPT9MByVy"][b]our Discord[/b][/url]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/10336f259fb1fc95eba6bb96643427d9e8828571.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Content Update v0.4.3 — Snap & Cap! 📸👒
notes.content:
Hey Cozy Caravaners!

You might’ve spotted a few hats making a surprise appearance last week (whoops... turns out fashion waits for no one 😅), but now they’re officially here, stitched up proper and ready to wear!

If you’ve ever raised an eyebrow at that big hat-shaped house tucked away in Bayside... well, good eye. That’s where you’ll now find [b]Millicent[/b], a master of millinery and fashion-forward thinking. Help them finish off their outfit, and they’ll enlist you on a grand hat hunt!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/75efe1febbab1b61f4a82d0831ecca8f8449ca06.jpg[/img]

Once unlocked, you’ll be able to snap photos of hats hidden all around the world—on farms, in cafés, down quiet streets, and maybe even tucked into odd corners. Bring your pictures back to Millicent, and they’ll craft a matching hat just for you. [i]How many can you find?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/9b84c557971e87024b7dc2e5540db5d3b79a61a2.gif[/img]

And speaking of collections, [b]any outfit packs you’ve purchased now come with their very own unique hats[/b]. Even if you haven’t made your way to Bayside just yet, you’ll still be able to access those stylish additions straight away. Oh, and yes, you can actually take them off now, too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/5a8cb16c0e7c7a0e51ea6adaa78b237d20a097c0.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
Whether you're out snapping photos, trying on new looks, or hunting down the perfect hat to finish your outfit, there’s plenty of fun to be had in this update!

As always, we’d love to see your favourite outfits, your most ridiculous combos, and whatever else you’ve been up to! Come hang out with us over on [url=https://discord.gg/dxPT9MByVy][b]our Discord[/b][/url], it’s the best place to chat with the devs, share your ideas, and compare headwear with other caravaners.

[url=https://discord.gg/dxPT9MByVy][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/10336f259fb1fc95eba6bb96643427d9e8828571.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Content Update v0.4.2 — Bubba Means Business!
notes.content:
Hey Cozy Caravaners!

Need a hand at the stall? Bubba’s got you covered. Misplaced someone’s delivery? Catto’s already on the case. This update brings a few handy new features and much-needed tweaks to help make life on the road a little smoother.

[h3]Markets Made Easier (Thanks, Bubba!)[/h3]
Markets have had a number of behind-the-scenes improvements, but the big one’s front and centre: once you’ve unlocked your first market table upgrade, you’ll gain the option to have Bubba take over the register for you!

And if you’re the ambitious type, markets can now be run [i]multiple times per day[/i]. Want to set up shop in different towns before sundown? Go for it—just mind the clock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/d01354a166c1ee2a4014729745f1fb5c398f4600.gif[/img]

[h3]Hot Commodities: In-Demand Items[/h3]
Each market location now features a rotating set of [i]in-demand items[/i], updated every two weeks. Sell these items at the right place and you’ll earn bonus happiness—plus, customers will be more likely to race over and snap them up.

Customer behaviour has also had some work: they’re now more likely to want in-demand items, Fortune items, or anything you’re actively holding or have placed on the table. Check the map anytime to see what’s hot where!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/6017263c7be1a02b79b8ad0cdca1bd8cd93f4347.png[/img]

[h3]Lost & Found (Thanks, Catto!)[/h3]
Dropped a delivery or lost a quest book somewhere on the road? No problem—Catto will now return any lost delivery items or books to you the next day.

We’ll be expanding this system in a future update to cover quest-specific items too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/c2f01be490eac533842dcfa9097b510b75a1eb64.png[/img]

notes.title: Content update v0.3.8 — Get those legs moving!
notes.content:
Hey Cozy Caravaners!

We hope you're ready to get that heart-rate up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/f9376d46a5aa8c8229973920ed81607e1381376e.gif[/img]

As the Whizz Bang Fair preparations continue, competitors are getting ready for one of its biggest events, the [i]Bumbling of the Bees[/i] — where competitors race around a track with big fluffy bumble bees hot on their heels. But it takes training and dedication to properly prepare, so this update sees a new running race activity! Meet up with Kyla & Xander, or with Theo & Hector as they train for the big day on race tracks laid out all over the region.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/361fa8a333665227840f3b763b02435c2996edc7.gif[/img]

But what gives you that competitive edge? There's a new upgrade available now, letting you sprint on command! Talk to Arthur at the Guild Hall to get your hands on this upgrade, which also grants Rigby a similar speed boost while driving the caravan. To take it to the next level, fuel up with a hearty meal when you set up camp each night - a tasty treat will give you both a much-needed energy boost!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/b82b9ef31f297bd581dd2f4ac287af0458d63b84.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/a63b5617393a5d1fc7a6c5c42842e308c40b9fd1.gif[/img]

You can change the controls for the new sprint from a hold to a toggle in the controls menu if that is more your style.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Roadmap[/h2]
It's been a while since Bubba's updated our roadmap, so we've asked him to have another pass on it. What's on the road ahead, Bubba?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/557a326d6386c0962fda0f167d19e40059f41082.png[/img]

After today's update, we'll be adjusting our release schedule once again to every three weeks (with hotfixes still coming sooner as needed). As we've mentioned before, every public release requires a bunch of extra work, so as we move closer to 1.0, this extra week between releases goes a long way to allowing us to stay in the zone and focus on completing new content, testing, optimising, and everything else that goes into game dev.

As always, thanks to everyone who submits bug reports, both on Discord and through the in-game reporting tool. Keep it up, it's a big help!

[url=https://discord.gg/dxPT9MByVy][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/10336f259fb1fc95eba6bb96643427d9e8828571.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Content Update v0.3.2 - Gone Fishin'!
notes.content:
Hey Cozy Caravaners!

Grab your waders, it's time to go fishing! Today, we've got our initial release of the fishing activity! You'll see some mysterious fish swimming about, and once you've acquired your very own fishing rod, you can kick back and drop in a line.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/c681971c40535afa64b88ad830a2eda22e5522c6.jpg[/img]

To get started, Mirela in Clamberry will need a courier for a ✨[b][i]special package[/i][/b]✨ addressed to Arthur at the Guild Hall. Lend a hand, and you'll see a new toy available in the Guild Catalogue.

To start with, there are a few different fish to find, and we'll be adding more in upcoming updates. Whenever you catch a fish for the first time (or a new size record), you'll pose for a photo to log it in your journal. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/34f5a24951303caff4eebb40f9f02913b96b3143.jpg[/img]

The fishing activity is still in a relatively early state, and we'll be continuing to refine and improve it, so we'd love to hear everyone's thoughts and ideas!

In addition, there's a new fishing-themed caravan decoration to celebrate the occasion, along with some new colour schemes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/27bb9fcbb5726e18a11c3af73c1eeb4aadb7b18c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/8fe26c76bc248c1480ae225e3c15a033f7f2dd79.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Recipe/outfit mix-ups fixed for various outfits.
[*]Logic fixed for applying frog stickers on postcards (not all stickers were showing up).
[*]Photo Topiary quest now continues properly.
[*]Bubba Chats no longer repeat existing conversations.
[*]Added backup system for recipe letters.
[*]Nightshade Outfit Pack outfit is no longer a craftable recipe.
[*]Book return text fixed for Mirela, Angela, and Dottie.
[*]Fix objectives for Grandma Dolly's Stew quest remaining on postcards even after completion.
[*]Various environmental collision fixes.
[*]Fixed the wrong photos being shown in the photo album pages.
[*]Fixed collision with some caravan customisation adornments.
[*]Fixed the road from Croaker's Gully to Grandview Gardens not requiring the muddy wheels upgrade (SEE NOTE BELOW)
[/list]
[i][b]NOTE:[/b][/i] If you used this road to go to Cottonbluff Cove before purchasing the muddy wheels upgrade, you will not be able to drive back to Harvestvale. But don't worry! You can use the "Help I'm Stuck" option in the settings menu to warp you and your caravan back to Fellowood Acres. Apologies!

[h2]Balance Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*]Station boosts decreased from 30% to 25%
[*]Big reduction in happiness required for guild tokens, level increment reduced from 20 to 10
[*]Increased guild token costs for most gameplay upgrades
[*]Recipe boost no longer stacks with ingredient boosts - Overall its a little quicker to get to the same level of upgrades, but the cosmetic upgrades are far less cost prohibitive.
[*]Activities now give one recipe per day, but it’s easier to get them, and all activities can now give recipes
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
Thanks as always for all of your feedback and assistance while we continue to build and grow the world of Cozy Caravan. We'd love to see you in our Discord server if you're not already there. Come say hello, we're very friendly!

notes.title: Visit Cottonbluff Cove! - Update 0.3.0
notes.content:
It’s time to hit the road and soak up some sun because [b]Cottonbluff Cove[/b] is now open to explore! This beautiful coastal region is packed with new places to visit, friendly faces to meet, and new crafting opportunities. So grab your sunscreen and let's get going!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/79c1cf60b8fca3b2aa0587b1d5e6e26b1b8c6fe1.png[/img]

[h2]Explore Cottonbluff Cove[/h2] Picture yourself strolling through the fishing town of Clamberry, chatting with the locals and picking up ingredients for your lovely new recipes. 🐟 When you're ready to relax, the sparkling beaches of Lugo Lago Springs are the perfect place to unwind. 🏖️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/d312ee56aadd20463bbfc164b187e692c77e63a6.jpg[/img]

Feeling inspired by the coastal breeze? Head over to the cotton farms of Spindle Way to gather fresh cotton, which you can use to craft fabrics. With those fabrics in hand, unlock patterns for stylish outfits to sew yourself. Whether it’s something new for you to wear or a creation to sell at the weekly market, your wardrobe is about to get a serious upgrade!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/c7386ff724ef2b548d0f606363a580247f7edbe0.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]Discover a whole new region! From the fishing town of Clamberry, to the stunning views at Clementine House, and more!
[*]Unlock the new sewing station in your caravan!
[*]Collect cotton to craft fabrics, craft dyes, and unlock patterns to sew stylish new outfits!
[*]Discover new recipes, help locals, and find new ingredients.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/b6e39245fa21c9dae84b34c4971e7674edec0c87.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/61acf5542a34b840692a3d1c894483a5157c0b11.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/507d7dfcf991e4c6ba3de2bedf89cd789559ec52.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.2.0 - Harvestvale South!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/6644a44a418d51237b8b4dca47e44e88393b3e76.jpg[/img]
[h2]Harvestvale South[/h2]
It's finally here! The people of Harvestvale South are ready for you and Bubba to come on over and spread some happiness. That is, once you've helped Bob and his crew wrap up their roadworks. Come on down, say hello, and see who can use the help of our two favourite Guild Rookies!

[h2]Quest Tracker[/h2]
But that's not all! This update also includes the first pass of the new 'quest tracker' functionality. It will (like many other parts of the game) continue to be tweaked and adjusted, but it's ready for people to start using and giving feedback on. As mentioned, we really wanted to have something that was suitably 'in-world' rather than a regular old checklist, so Aunty Mads has declared Bubba take on the role of "Chief Scribbler"—taking notes on the backs of postcards as you help people out around the world.

[h2]A Note About Saves[/h2]
With this release, we've made some adjustments to the overall pacing of the game. In order to give quests at a more controlled pace, we've introduced prerequisites for certain quests. This means that for new games, certain existing quests won't be available until some other condition is met (e.g. completing another quest, unlocking an upgrade, etc). However, for existing saves, this might mean that some players will see quests they've already completed become active again. But rest assured, [b]any items, recipes, happiness, etc. you've accumulated are unaffected and will still be present.[/b]

[h2]Steam Deck[/h2]
We've also done a little work on Steam Deck support. It should now automatically pop up the keyboard at the name entry screen during character creation. We've also submitted this build for verification with Valve in hopes of getting Cozy Caravan verified for Steam Deck. Hopefully that should at least remove the "Unsupported" label on Cozy Caravan once they've had a chance to review it. 🤞

[h2]Roadmap[/h2]
Bubba, can you put your Chief Scribbler talents to work and show where we're at on the roadmap?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/b2be3bf2ce67d984a307a77a23c4ed80ae19837b.png[/img]

[h2]General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added Harvestvale south, along with associated quests, characters, and items.
[*]Added quest tracker to map screen.
[*]Made pacing changes to quest unlocking. Various quests now have prerequisites to enable them, to help spread things out a little more consistently. (For some players, this will re-enable some quests they have already completed. However, you won't lose any inventory or recipe unlocks).
[*]Added a navigation path to the map screen when transporting a hitchhiker.
[*]Collecting eggs now requires the wrangling of some begerks.
[*]Added some new photo-mode poses.
[*]Updated the spawning of world activities to give a better variety.
[*]Improvements to the timing window on Hopscotch.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
There's been a lot of changes on this build, so we'd be here all day if we listed every fix, so here are some of the more noteworthy.
[list]
[*]Fixed some items which, when in the player's backpack, would launch the caravan into the air while driving. While very funny, it wasn't very helpful.
[*]Fixed some objects not appearing during crafting.
[*]Improved the behaviour of the direction arrow while carrying hitchhikers on the caravan.
[*]Fixed a possible crash while carrying hitchhikers.
[*]Fixed some produce at farms being spawned under the ground.
[*]Fix the till at markets not playing animations.
[*]Improve pop-in while loading saves.
[*]Fixed a bug causing the waiter mini-game to get stuck in a state where patrons wanted their empty glasses removed when none was present.
[/list]
As always, feedback from players is incredibly helpful, so if you haven't already, [b][url=https://discord.gg/dxPT9MByVy]we'd love to see you in our Discord server[/url][/b]. Many of the really impactful improvements and bug-fixes we've made since launch have been because of the help and feedback of our community, so it truly does help make the game better! That, and the lovely words of praise and encouragement to the team truly do keep us going, so thank you! 💓

We've still got loads to add to Cozy Caravan, and we're excited to have you all along with us for the journey!

notes.title: Content Update v0.1.1.260
notes.content:
Hi everyone! It's been a week since we launched Cozy Caravan on Steam, and we've been overwhelmed with all of the wonderful words you've had for the team. Thank you all so much, it truly does mean a lot to us. It can be very scary putting your work out into the world, especially with Early Access, with all the rough edges and content still-to-come. But seeing everyone's reactions, your character photos, and compliments to the team means everything to us. Thank you all!

And with that out of the way, we've got another update today, with our first batch of new content. We're beginning to release new outfits for the wardrobe, and we'll have new drops regularly over the course of Early Access (we're aiming to have something new each week). Some of these, like today, will be available immediately in the character creator and in your wardrobe (go talk to Arthur if you haven't got yourself a wardrobe yet!). Moving forward, we'll have a mix of instantly-available outfits, and ones that will be unlocked through the guild catalogue, or by ✨[i]some other means yet to be revealed[/i].✨

Here are the new threads you'll find in your wardrobes today!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/0e0a89d8bba5f9eeb10ae93b8b6082d71d43a1a8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/91f8ae8fa369ebb9d5afc001082e7c480c7194fc.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/f061c7476389dd6b2ec184811561aa2b214864e3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/8a1dfda87fd13d05b2cdcf65e98529792781114c.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/dd0a61219ab933e3ba99f57d3efedd00e876fc63.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/f939d5b87c14b9ef62f8464bb3a46d28c29d608d.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/f32ca1750757a73f809bbfd5d51e8c0848a67196.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/c03ed5cdb48a54c7b550348b0b8f9c11d09c3ee5.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where Luca would act as though you've already found him instead of offering to re-play hide-and-seek.
[*]Fix the market bell sometimes being invisible.
[*]Fix to prevent the player from getting out of the caravan in unintended locations.
[*]Fix where the heart/happiness sound effects would get stuck on.
[*]Fix an issue where the conversation box would sometimes get stuck on when talking to Yas the Librarian.
[/list]

[h2]Analytics[/h2]
We've added an optional feature utilising Unity Analytics. You'll see a one-time pop-up which you can choose to accept or decline. This information is used purely for us to learn how people are playing Cozy Caravan, and in turn help us make informed decisions as we continue to develop the game. Again, this is [b]totally optional[/b], and you're more than welcome to decline, it's just one way you can help us improve the Cozy Caravan experience.

[h2]Roadmap[/h2]
We've asked Bubba if he can scribble down an Early Access roadmap for us. He hasn't quite got all the details in there yet, but we'll update you all when he's cleaned it up a bit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44865511/65ef4174e5cb5702cba1dd302e3427c65c2f512a.png[/img]

Our next major release will be [b]0.2.0[/b], where the [b]rest of Harvestvale[/b] will be available to explore! Each week between now and then, we'll have new outfits ready to share, along with the usual bevy of bug fixes and improvements thanks to the feedback from our players.

[h2]Quest Tracker[/h2]
But that's not all! Before that update, we're aiming to have the much-requested [b]Quest Tracker[/b] released. We're trying to make sure we do this in a way which fits the cozy vibe and feels like it's part of the world, while still being functional and informative. We appreciate all of your feedback on this. We've heard loud and clear! This will be on top of the continued work on the last patch to improve how quest-help lines are delivered by NPCs.

That's all for this update. Thank you again, and we look forward to chatting more with you on our Discord as we work together to bring Cozy Caravan towards the finish line!

notes.title: Early Access Hotfix v0.1.0.240
notes.content:
Hey Cozy Caravaners! We've got another batch of fixes and improvements. Big thanks to everyone who's been sharing feedback and helping us track down these pesky bugs! Don’t forget to [url=https://discord.gg/dxPT9MByVy][b]join our Discord server[/b][/url] to chat with us, report issues, or just show off cute pics of your character!

Here’s what’s new in this update:

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Fixed a bug which could cause a freeze if a player clicked on the caravan and brought up the map while the character is still walking towards the caravan. This was a tricky one to find!
    [*]Added an emergency feature: Press F11 to output a screenshot with debug info for players to send us in case of issues. It will be in the same folder as the Photo Mode images.
    [*]Updated the fonts to include the extended ASCII character set. 
    [*]Improved the post-market screen to correctly show the amount of items sold.
    [*]Fixed Winston's gate being incorrectly fixed/closed when you need to herd bees.
    [*]Fixed a duplicate Hershey appearing when loading a save after finishing the Jimothy quest.
    [*]Fix hopscotch in some areas clipping through the floor.
    [*]Fix an unintentional upgrade requirement for the rolling pin. Recipes requiring the rolling pin are now craftable with the base cooking table.
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay Improvements[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Rigby now gives a tail wag and hearts when you give him a pet! You can do it once every day.
    [*]Initial rework of the quest helper system to give more sensible lines and avoid lines from locked areas.
    [*]Improved the Stew quest to allow players to follow up on clues even if not all clues have been found. If you're stuck part-way this one, chat to Ellie (the quest-giver in Hershey's Homestead) and it should update everything to the correct state.
[/list]

Thanks for helping us make Cozy Caravan even better! If you run into any more issues or just want to hang out, hop on over to our Discord. Happy adventuring!

notes.title: Early Access Hotfix 1
notes.content:
Hot off the build machine (who we've affectionately named Shredder), we've got our first hotfix for Cozy Caravan! Thanks so much to everyone for their wonderful feedback, and for sharing save and log files for us to track down issues. 

And if you haven't already, we invite you to [url=https://discord.gg/dxPT9MByVy][b]join our Discord server[/b][/url], where you can chat with us directly, whether it’s to report an issue, or share cute pictures of your character with us and your fellow players. We'd love you to help us make Cozy Caravan even better!

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Resolved an issue causing empty dialogue boxes to pop up and create a soft hang.
    [*]Fixed a bug where players could get stuck in the caravan after loading a save during the Escaping Bees mission and others.
    [*]Fixed a hang that occurred when talking to Lucy for the second time.
    [*]Possible fix for the photo mode pose getting stuck. Please let us know if you encounter this issue again.
    [*]Fix a soft-lock when waving at people when exiting the market.
    [*]Fix an issue where repeatedly mashing the interact on the bed will progress time by several days.
    [*]Players can no longer get trapped behind the hay pile when helping Dill in the tutorial.
    [*]Fixed an issue where entering the item sort via keyboard with only one item could cause a soft-lock.
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay Improvements[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Temporarily stop hitchhikers from getting off the caravan if you go too far off-course.
    [*]Guild Rep Arthur will no longer tell the player to show him a salad after making it.
    [*]Smoothed out movement playback on the map.
    [*]Resolved issues with Jean Pierre and Carmel Sundae quests repeating.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! It really is so incredibly helpful. We'll be back with more updates soon!
